body:
3 new procedural textures (concrete/wood/metal) alongside brick. level_boxes.h resolves per-wall material name to shading params; physics.h carries a small material table + per-box index. New material_shaders.h: a real, additive Blinn-Phong specular pass (packages/render/gl_shader.c gained glUniform3fv/1f wrappers), gated on a real specular threshold so brick/concrete/wood cost nothing extra. Also fixes a real, separately-found bug: level_select_confirm() never set the player entity's own scene_id, so draw_scene's own per-frame resync silently reverted a picked custom level back to garage the next frame -- likely broken in real play until this fix. Both binaries build clean. Live-verified end to end via Xvfb + a real 4-material level (debug confirmed correct material resolution and specular draw-gate). All temp code reverted. Commit 5a8da61.

⚓ ☃
title: Ship native block materials + real Blinn-Phong specular shader
